text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At last, the day of Winning Ticket's debut has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, I must keep her spirits high, because she starts getting itchy when she feels anxious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Overcoming her nerves—and itchiness—she heads off to her debut!
